newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan cancels 50,000 T feed barley tender -trade.
newsitem.headline: Jordan cancels 50,000 T feed barley tender -trade.

text.p: Jordan cancelled a tender to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. feed barley or equivalent origin after its latest purchase of 100,000 tonnes of Syrian black barley, traders said on Monday.
Traders said Jordan's Ministry of Supply cancelled the tender for U.S. origin barley under the GSM 102 programme for shipment by end of January. Results of the tender had been due next Thursday.

Jordan bought 100,000 tonnes of black barley at $138 per tonne from Syria after a delegation from the ministry reached agreement during talks on Sunday in Damascus with Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade.
